theorems.name: Submission.varifold_tangents_radial_stationary_homogeneous
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (C : Varifold N n (univ : Set (Euclidean N))), C.Stationary → (∀ᵐ z ∂C.measure, Grassmannian.project z.2 z.1 = z.1) → ∀ (s : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclidean N)), 0 < s → C.weight (s • A) = ENNReal.ofReal s ^ n * C.weight A
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
